integrity_statement: Algebraic all-size argument with supplementary finite exhaustive and exact-rational checks; no independent validation or external certification.
scientific_limitations: Asymptotic covariance density assumes two fixed distinct run lengths and an interior success fraction.
Finite covariance need not have the limiting sign at phase boundaries.
Only fully bounded internal runs are counted; endpoint-touching/circular runs are different.
The classical conditional joint generating function determines finite moments in principle; priority for the specialized phase diagram remains subject to independent comparison.
No growing-run-length asymptotics or joint central limit theorem are asserted.
title: A Pell-indexed covariance phase diagram for run-length spectra of fixed-composition binary words
